Reads a deterministic AX target, inserts an unrelated sibling, reads the target again, and requires the raw backendDOMNodeId or MCP uid mapping to remain stable. [scenario:agentloop_ax_id_stable_across_mutation driver:playwright]

Fetches the full accessibility tree through each driver's own CDP route, finds a deterministic button, and requires its role, computed accessible name, and backendDOMNodeId to survive the adapter boundary. [scenario:agentloop_ax_role_name_ids driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds one item, and answers with the server-computed cart total. [scenario:app_add_single_item driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds an item, reloads the document, and answers with the total restored from server state. [scenario:app_cart_persists_reload driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds two items with different prices, and answers with the aggregated total. [scenario:app_cart_total_two_items driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds one item, checks out, and answers with the order id the server derived from the cart. [scenario:app_checkout_receipt driver:playwright]
Logs in, types a filter prefix, and answers with the live match counter. [scenario:app_filter_narrows driver:playwright]
Logs in, filters to the gizmo group, adds the first match, and answers with its cart line. [scenario:app_filter_then_add driver:playwright]
Runs the entire flow and answers with greeting plus receipt, every part server-computed. [scenario:app_full_flow_aggregate driver:playwright]
Clears any leftover session cookie, reloads, and confirms the server refuses the item list. [scenario:app_locked_without_login driver:playwright]
Fills the user field, logs in, and answers with the greeting the server echoed back. [scenario:app_login_greets driver:playwright]
Logs in, logs out, and answers with the server farewell plus the relocked list marker. [scenario:app_logout_locks driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds one item twice, and answers with the cart line plus total. [scenario:app_qty_accumulates driver:playwright]
Logs in, adds two items, removes one, and answers with the corrected total. [scenario:app_remove_item driver:playwright]

Calls CSS.getComputedStyleForNode through each raw-capable driver, requires at least 100 distinct properties, and verifies display, visibility, opacity, and pointer-events remain readable. [scenario:computed_style_breadth driver:playwright]

Sets a window global in one evaluate call and derives a value from it in a second call. A driver that evaluates each expression in a throwaway context (or a fresh isolated world) fails here. [scenario:cs_eval_context_persists driver:playwright]

Sets a window global on the first page, then creates a new page on the same URL and confirms the global is absent. Exercises that new targets get fresh execution contexts rather than reusing the old page's world. [scenario:cs_fresh_page_no_stale_globals driver:playwright]

Navigates and immediately asks the page for its readyState through the driver's evaluate surface. A driver that returns from goto before the document settles fails here. [scenario:cs_ready_state_complete driver:playwright]

Navigates the first page to the core fixture, creates a second page, navigates it to /page2 and reads its heading. The first page's location must not constrain the second target's navigation. [scenario:cs_second_page_independent_nav driver:playwright]

Creates three pages in sequence, navigating each, and reads the heading from the last one. Exercises session/bookkeeping stability across repeated target creation within one attempt. [scenario:cs_session_survives_three_pages driver:playwright]

Fills an input on the first page, then creates a second page on the same fixture and confirms its input is untouched. Exercises multi-target isolation within one driver session. [scenario:cs_two_pages_isolated driver:playwright]

Reads the user agent through the driver's own identity surface and through page JavaScript. Exercises the session's identity plumbing end to end; every engine spoofs a Mozilla-family UA, so the page-observed value must contain 'Mozilla/'. [scenario:cs_ua_surface driver:playwright]

Navigates to the core fixture and reads the current URL through the driver's own url surface (not page JS). The reported location must contain the fixture path. [scenario:cs_url_surface driver:playwright]
Clicks the attachment link, captures the download to the artifact dir, and answers with the probe-computed sha256 prefix and size of the saved bytes. [scenario:dl_download_checksum driver:playwright]
Arms an auto-accept dialog handler, clicks a button whose handler alerts a script-computed message, and answers with the recorded dialog log. [scenario:dlg_alert_message driver:playwright]
Arms an accepting dialog handler and clicks a button whose confirm() result is written into the DOM with a computed suffix. [scenario:dlg_confirm_accept driver:playwright]
Arms a dismissing dialog handler and confirms the page observes confirm() === false. [scenario:dlg_confirm_dismiss driver:playwright]
Arms an accepting dialog handler carrying prompt text and confirms the page receives exactly that text instead of the default. [scenario:dlg_prompt_text driver:playwright]

One click raises an alert then a confirm; the armed handler must resolve both so the page reaches its computed end state, and the dialog log must show both entries. [scenario:dlg_sequence_two_dialogs driver:playwright]

Clicks #counter-btn three times on the probe controls page; each click increments the #press-count output via a JS handler. Reads the final tally. Exercises repeated pointer dispatch and observation of client-side state accumulation. [scenario:dyn_counter_clicks driver:playwright]

On the paging fixture each #next click advances a counter and fetches that page's datum over XHR. The final datum P3-FINAL-73 exists only on page 3, reachable after two clicks, so it can only be read by waiting for each async update. Exercises polling/event-driven waiting across real network round-trips. [scenario:dyn_paging_final driver:playwright]

Checks the #checkbox input and reads its live .checked property via evaluate. Exercises the check contract: the driver must toggle the control to a checked state observable on the DOM property, not merely dispatch a click. [scenario:form_checkbox_check driver:playwright]

Checks the #agree checkbox on the probe controls page; the change handler writes 'checked' into #agree-out. Reads it back. Unlike a bare .checked read, this asserts the driver's check dispatches a real change event the page can react to. [scenario:form_checkbox_event driver:playwright]
Fills the same input twice; fill semantics require clear-then-set, so only the second value must remain. [scenario:form_fill_overwrites driver:playwright]

Fills the #field text input with a distinctive value and reads it back via input_value. Exercises the fill contract end to end: the driver must set the input's live value and observe it, proving keyboard/value semantics rather than just a DOM attribute. [scenario:form_fill_readback driver:playwright]
Focuses the core text field through each driver's public route or documented Runtime.evaluate fallback, then verifies the page's active element. [scenario:form_focus_active_element driver:playwright]
Clicks the label (not the checkbox) and reads the change-handler output; label activation semantics must reach the associated control. [scenario:form_label_click_toggles driver:playwright]
Presses Enter inside a text field whose keydown handler records the event; exercises real key-event dispatch, not value mutation. [scenario:form_press_enter_handler driver:playwright]
Clicks the second radio in a group and derives which one the group reports as checked. [scenario:form_radio_pick driver:playwright]

Selects the Engineering option in the #dept dropdown on the probe controls page; the page's change handler writes 'picked:eng' into #dept-out. Reads it back. Exercises select_option and confirms the driver triggers the change event rather than only setting value. [scenario:form_select_option driver:playwright]

Fills the query input, clicks submit, waits for the reloaded document, and reads the server-echoed query value. Exercises the full fill -> submit -> navigation -> readback chain. [scenario:form_submit_roundtrip driver:playwright]
Fills a textarea and reads its live value through the driver. [scenario:form_textarea_fill driver:playwright]

Both static children post a greeting on load; the parent collects them and answers with the sorted join, proving frame scripts executed and the message channel works. [scenario:fr_child_posts_parent driver:playwright]

Sets a marker on the parent, navigates the first child frame to a new URL, and answers with the child's new message plus proof the parent was not reloaded. [scenario:fr_child_self_navigation driver:playwright]

Inserts an iframe served from the localhost alias of the fixture origin (different origin string, same server), waits for it to load, and confirms the same-origin policy throws SecurityError on document access. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_blocked driver:playwright]

Inserts a cross-origin child and reads its script-computed message via a frame-scoped evaluate, the only legal route into a cross-origin frame. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_frame_evaluate driver:playwright]
Inserts a third iframe after load and reads its script-computed message once the new frame's document is live. [scenario:fr_dynamic_iframe_attach driver:playwright]

Counts frames before and after inserting a child that itself embeds a grandchild, answering with the observed growth of the reachable same-origin tree. [scenario:fr_frame_tree_shape driver:playwright]
Records the initial frame count, removes the first static iframe, waits for the tree to shrink, and answers with the before:after counts. [scenario:fr_iframe_detach driver:playwright]

Inserts a child that embeds its own child; the top document reads the grandchild's script-computed message through two levels of same-origin frame traversal. [scenario:fr_nested_two_levels driver:playwright]

Under site isolation a cross-origin iframe runs out-of-process; the driver must still enumerate it, evaluate inside it, and observe the frame tree shrink after removal. [scenario:fr_oopif_attach_read_detach driver:playwright]
Pokes a computed value into child A's note element and answers with both children's notes, proving sibling frame documents are distinct. [scenario:fr_sibling_isolation driver:playwright]
Waits for both static children to load and reads the first child's script-computed message through the frame tree. [scenario:fr_static_child_read driver:playwright]
Reads #lead + .next through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_adjacent_sibling driver:playwright]

Clicks a button addressed by [data-x="go-7"] and reads its handler output. Exercises attribute-selector support in the driver's element resolution. [scenario:loc_attribute_selector_click driver:playwright]
Counts .card elements through the driver's count surface. [scenario:loc_class_count driver:playwright]
Reads #zone .value where an identical .value also exists outside #zone; the scoped match must win. [scenario:loc_descendant_scope driver:playwright]
Waits for a srcdoc iframe's document and reads a value computed inside it via contentDocument traversal. [scenario:loc_iframe_same_origin_read driver:playwright]
Both the top document and the iframe contain #dup. The driver's selector surface must return the TOP document's element. [scenario:loc_iframe_scope_top_document driver:playwright]
Reads a selector that matches nothing; the op must fail cleanly (step_fails) and the attempt derives its answer from that failure. [scenario:loc_missing_element_fails_cleanly driver:playwright]
Reads li:nth-child(2) from a three-item list through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_nth_child_text driver:playwright]
The page attaches a closed shadow root; element.shadowRoot must be null while the host still renders. Confirms closed-mode encapsulation. [scenario:loc_shadow_closed_hidden driver:playwright]

The page attaches an open shadow root at load. Reads the shadow content via explicit shadowRoot traversal - the engine must implement attachShadow and expose shadowRoot. [scenario:loc_shadow_open_pierce driver:playwright]

Fills #textbox with a five-character value on the probe controls page; the input handler writes the live length into #textbox-len. Reads it back. Exercises selector resolution plus input-event-derived DOM observation. [scenario:locator_textbox_len driver:playwright]
Opens two live targets, reads a distinct heading from each, and aggregates both values in the second tab through same-origin session state. [scenario:multi_tab_collect driver:playwright]
Navigates core -> page2, then drives the browser's history back through the driver's own surface and confirms the first document's heading is restored. [scenario:nav_back_restores driver:playwright]

Navigates to the core fixture, then to a second page, and reads the second page's #title. Exercises a second full navigation (document swap) and confirms the driver observes the new document rather than the stale first one. [scenario:nav_cross_page driver:playwright]
Navigates core -> page2, goes back, then forward again, and reads the second document's heading. [scenario:nav_forward_after_back driver:playwright]
Sets location.hash in-page and confirms both the hash and that no document reload happened (a marker global survives). [scenario:nav_hash_change driver:playwright]
Pushes a same-document history entry with a query string and derives the new search plus proof that the document did not reload. [scenario:nav_push_state driver:playwright]
Pushes a same-document entry, then drives history back through the driver and confirms the original URL is restored without a reload. [scenario:nav_push_state_back driver:playwright]

Navigates to an endpoint that 302-redirects twice before landing on a page carrying a redirect-count marker. The driver must settle on the FINAL document. [scenario:nav_redirect_chain driver:playwright]

Fills an input, reloads the page, and confirms the fresh document no longer carries the typed value. Exercises Page.reload semantics: a real reload must produce a new document, not restore transient DOM state. [scenario:nav_reload_resets_dom driver:playwright]

Navigates to the core fixture, reloads it, and re-reads #title. Exercises the reload lifecycle: the driver must drive a fresh document load and still resolve the selector against the reloaded page. [scenario:nav_reload_title driver:playwright]

Pushes one history entry, replaces it in place, then navigates back once. If replaceState correctly rewrote the pushed entry, a single back lands on the original URL with no query string. A driver or engine that materialises replaceState as an extra entry lands on the intermediate URL instead. [scenario:nav_replace_state_collapses_entry driver:playwright]

Navigates to an endpoint that holds the response for 1.2s before serving the document. A driver that gives up early or reads before the body arrives fails. [scenario:nav_slow_document driver:playwright]

Opens a page, navigates to the core fixture, and reads the #title heading text. Exercises the most basic navigation + DOM-read contract that every driver must honor. [scenario:nav_title_read driver:playwright]
Arms an abort route on the pixel image, then triggers an image load; the page's onerror handler must fire. [scenario:net_abort_subresource_image driver:playwright]

Fetches the protected endpoint without credentials (observes 401), then arms the Authorization header and fetches again; the page accumulates the two-phase trace. [scenario:net_auth_challenge_then_pass driver:playwright]
Sets a bearer token via extra headers and fetches the protected endpoint; the server must accept and return its computed body. [scenario:net_auth_header_roundtrip driver:playwright]
Arms a fulfill route on a virtual path and navigates to it; the rendered document must be the mock, proving document-level interception. [scenario:net_document_fulfill driver:playwright]
Sets an x-abb header on the session and fetches the echo endpoint; the server-rendered echo must contain exactly the driver's header value. [scenario:net_extra_headers_echo driver:playwright]
Arms a fulfill route on /net/data only, then fetches /net/data and /net/other together; the answer must show the first mocked and the second real. [scenario:net_mock_only_matching driver:playwright]
Starts request recording, triggers a fetch, and answers with the recorded request log filtered to the data endpoint. [scenario:net_request_recorded driver:playwright]
Arms an abort route on the data endpoint; the page fetch must reject and the page records the error name. [scenario:net_route_abort_handled driver:playwright]
Fulfills the data endpoint as text/csv; the page reads the response content-type header. [scenario:net_route_content_type driver:playwright]
Arms a fulfill route on the data endpoint; the page fetch must observe the mocked payload, not the server one. [scenario:net_route_mock_json driver:playwright]
Control case for the family: with no interception armed, the page fetch must hit the real endpoint and compute from the server payload. [scenario:net_route_passthrough driver:playwright]
Fulfills the data endpoint with a 503; the page must observe exactly that status. [scenario:net_route_rewrite_status driver:playwright]
Takes an ARIA snapshot of the main region and checks the computed heading appears in the structured output. [scenario:obs_aria_snapshot_structure driver:playwright]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks the computed heading text is exposed on the tree. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_heading driver:playwright]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks it contains the accessible name that the page computed at load. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_label driver:playwright]
Reads the bounding box of a 120x48 element and answers with its rounded dimensions — the box-model observation surface. [scenario:obs_box_model_geometry driver:playwright]
Clicks a button that emits console.error and answers with the driver's console capture. [scenario:obs_console_error_captured driver:playwright]
Clicks a button that logs a computed message and answers with the driver's console capture. [scenario:obs_console_log_captured driver:playwright]
Answers with the live document title joined with the pathname — the most basic observation pair every driver must expose. [scenario:obs_title_url_surface driver:playwright]
Computes a visibility matrix over a visible and a hidden element from live layout state. [scenario:obs_visibility_matrix driver:playwright]
Sets a cookie via document.cookie and parses it back out of the cookie string. [scenario:st_cookie_document_roundtrip driver:playwright]
Sets a cookie, reloads, and parses the cookie back. Exercises cookie-jar persistence across navigation. [scenario:st_cookie_survives_reload driver:playwright]
Writes a localStorage key and reads it back through a second evaluate call. The value is computed at write time, never present in the page. [scenario:st_local_roundtrip driver:playwright]

Writes localStorage in the first page, creates a second page on the same origin, and reads the key there. Same-origin pages must observe one storage area. [scenario:st_local_shared_same_origin driver:playwright]
Writes a localStorage key, reloads the page, and reads the key back. Exercises storage persistence across the driver's reload path. [scenario:st_local_survives_reload driver:playwright]

Writes sessionStorage in the first page, creates a fresh page on the same origin, and confirms the key is absent there - sessionStorage is per top-level browsing context. [scenario:st_session_isolated_new_page driver:playwright]
Writes and reads a sessionStorage key within one page session. [scenario:st_session_storage_roundtrip driver:playwright]
Writes two keys, removes one, and derives which keys remain. [scenario:st_storage_remove driver:playwright]

Attaches the payload to a bare file input (no submit); the page's change handler reads it with FileReader and writes a computed digest of length and first token. [scenario:up_upload_filereader driver:playwright]

Writes a payload file, attaches it to the form input, submits, and answers with the server-rendered upload receipt (name, size, sha256 prefix) — graded server-side against the known payload. [scenario:up_upload_server_checksum driver:playwright]
An attribute is set 300ms after load. Waits for it via predicate, then reads it through the driver's attribute surface (not page JS). [scenario:wait_attribute_set driver:playwright]

An element visible at load is display:none'd after 300ms. Waits for the hidden state via a predicate and reports it; a driver that only waits for presence passes too early. [scenario:wait_element_hidden driver:playwright]

A button starts disabled and is enabled 350ms after load; its click handler is attached at enable time. Waits for enablement, clicks, and reads the handler's output. [scenario:wait_enabled_then_click driver:playwright]

Navigates to the probe controls page and waits for #late-item, which the page appends via setTimeout ~300ms after load, then reads its text. Exercises event-driven waiting for a DOM node that does not exist at load time. [scenario:wait_late_item driver:playwright]
Three list items are appended at 150/300/450ms. Waits until all three exist and derives the joined item text. [scenario:wait_list_progressive_fill driver:playwright]
Waits for a span inserted 400ms after load and reads its computed text. A driver that only samples the initial DOM misses it. [scenario:wait_slow_badge driver:playwright]
A container holds a spinner that is replaced with content 500ms after load. Waits for the spinner to disappear and reads the replacement. [scenario:wait_spinner_replaced driver:playwright]

The status text changes twice (warming -> phase:1 -> phase:2:W7). Waits for the FINAL state; a driver that returns on the first mutation reads the intermediate value. [scenario:wait_two_phase_settle driver:playwright]

on_framework_main_path: page.check drives the coordinate click chain. Real Playwright checks #agree and selects the 'eng' option of #dept; the fixture's change listeners mirror both into outputs. Passes when isChecked is true, #agree-out reads 'checked', and #dept-out reads 'picked:eng'.

on_framework_main_path: coordinate clicks are Playwright's true pointer channel (scrollIntoView + getContentQuads + Input.dispatchMouseEvent). Real Playwright clicks #add3 three times on the v0.2 counter fixture and reads #total. Passes when the total equals 9, proving the full hit-target coordinate click chain works.

Real Playwright fills #textbox with a 14-character string; the fixture's own input listener writes the current length into #textbox-len. Passes when the value reads back exactly and the page-side length output shows 14, proving fill dispatches real input events (Input.insertText path) rather than silently setting .value.

Real Playwright focuses #keys, types 'abc' through the keyboard API, then presses Enter. The fixture counts keydown events and flags Enter. Passes when the keydown count is 4 and the enter flag reads 'yes', proving Input.dispatchKeyEvent delivers trusted key events the page can observe.

Calibration against v2_h_compute_product (same fixture, same expected result): real Playwright clicks #go through its true pointer path (on_framework_main_path) and reads #result, which the page computes from body data attributes (6*7+7 = 49). Raw-CDP replay clicked via Runtime.evaluate; divergence isolates the coordinate click channel on a single-action page.

Calibration against v2_h_counter_clicks (same fixture, same expected total): real Playwright connects over CDP, clicks #add3 three times and #add5 twice through its true pointer path (on_framework_main_path: scrollIntoView + getContentQuads + Input.dispatchMouseEvent), and reads back the running total. Raw-CDP replay drove the same fixture via Runtime.evaluate clicks; divergence here isolates the coordinate action channel.

Calibration against v2_h_form_checksum (same fixture, same input string): real Playwright fills #name with the exact string 'abz' that the raw-CDP replay typed via Input.insertText, clicks #compute through the real pointer path (on_framework_main_path), and reads the page-computed checksum (sum of char codes mod 1000 = 317). Same input, same expected output keeps the Stage D comparison apples-to-apples; divergence isolates the framework fill/click channel versus raw insertText.

Calibration against v2_h_frame_token (same fixture, same expected token): real Playwright navigates to the parent page, resolves the same-origin child frame from its frame tree (url contains 'frames_child'), and evaluates inside that frame to read #ctoken, which the child computes by reversing its data-src attribute ('xy9' -> '9yx'). Raw-CDP replay read the token via window.frames[0] from the parent context; divergence isolates the framework's frame enumeration/session model.

Calibration against v2_ifx_mock_api_rewrite (same app fixture, same mock-supersedes-origin semantics): real Playwright registers a route on **/v0_2/ifx/api-primary that fulfills with an injected JSON body, then triggers the page helper __abbApiField() which fetches that route and renders the parsed 'answer' field. The asserted value 'V3-MOCK-PW-K3F9' exists only in this task's injected body, never on the origin route (which serves a decoy), so a pass proves the framework's interception path (Fetch enable/fulfillRequest) actually rewired the response. Raw-CDP replay did the same via manual Fetch.requestPaused handling.

Playwright-only surface: the user_agent op internally opens a browser-level CDP session via browser.newBrowserCDPSession() and sends Browser.getVersion on it. Passes when the returned userAgent is a non-empty browser UA string, proving the engine accepts an explicit attach to the browser target.

Real Playwright connects to the engine over CDP (connectOverCDP) and reads the browser version and user agent without opening any page. Passes when both identity strings are non-empty, proving the bootstrap handshake (Target.setAutoAttach + Browser.getVersion) completed against the engine under test.

Real Playwright creates a fresh page target (no navigation, about:blank execution context) and evaluates 6*7. Passes when the evaluation returns 42, proving Target.createTarget plus a working Runtime.evaluate round-trip on the new target.

Real Playwright opens two page targets in sequence: the first evaluation plants a window global and returns a distinct value, the second page evaluates its own distinct value and probes for the first page's global. Passes when each page returns its own value and the second page does NOT see the first page's global, proving multi-target attach with isolated sessions/contexts.

Real Playwright sets a cookie on the fixture URL through context.addCookies, reads it back through context.cookies, and also reads document.cookie inside the page. Passes when both readbacks contain the name/value pair, proving the Network/Storage cookie write and both read paths agree.

Real Playwright evaluates a self-invoking function that maps and reduces an array ((3+5+7+9)*2 = 48). Passes when the returned value is 48, proving Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue handles non-trivial expressions.

Real Playwright captures the whole page HTML via page.content() after navigating to the core fixture. Passes when the serialized document contains both the fixture title and the bottom-of-page marker, proving full-document serialization works.

Real Playwright reads the core fixture DOM three ways: textContent of #title, the placeholder attribute of #field, and the count of .para paragraphs. Passes when all three match the fixture's known values, proving the callFunctionOn-based DOM read surface works.

Real Playwright fills #textbox on the controls fixture and reads the value back via page.inputValue(). Passes when the read-back equals the exact filled string, proving the value-read path (Runtime.callFunctionOn on the element) reflects the fill.

Real Playwright registers a route that aborts **/v0_3/api/blocked, then the page fetches that URL; the fetch Promise must reject and the evaluate resolves through the catch branch. Passes when the saved outcome is 'FETCH_FAILED', proving Fetch.failRequest interception works.

Real Playwright registers a route that fulfills **/v0_3/api/probe with a mock JSON token, then the page fetches that URL and returns the parsed token (evaluate awaits the returned Promise). Passes when the token equals the injected mock value, proving the Fetch.enable/fulfillRequest interception path works.

Real Playwright navigates core -> page2, then goes back (URL must contain /l1/core, restored DOM title must read 'CDP Core Fixture') and forward again (URL must contain /page2, title 'Page Two'), proving Page.navigateToHistoryEntry drives real history hops. The hops are graded by post-navigation URL + DOM rather than the goBack/goForward return value: against an externally launched Chrome (no --disable-back-forward-cache), bfcache restores emit no load event, so Playwright's lifecycle wait inside goBack/goForward times out even though the history navigation itself commits correctly; the hops carry a short 3s timeout and are marked optional for that reason.

Real Playwright navigates a fresh page to the fixture and captures the navigation response status plus the resulting page URL. Passes when the status is 200 and the URL contains the fixture path, proving Page.navigate plus lifecycle settlement work end to end.

Real Playwright navigates, plants a window global via evaluate, reloads the page, then reads the global back. Passes when the pre-reload write is observed and the post-reload read is 'undefined', proving Page.reload actually re-created the JS world rather than reusing the old context.

Real Playwright navigates to the core fixture and reads back the document title and current URL through the framework API. Passes when the title equals the fixture's known title and the URL contains the fixture path.

Real Playwright navigates to the controls fixture where a script appends #late-item 300ms after load, then waits for that selector and reads its text. Passes when the wait resolves and the text equals the computed marker 'late-28', proving the polling/injected-helper wait machinery works on this engine.

Real Playwright captures an accessibility snapshot of the controls fixture (probe tries page.accessibility.snapshot first, falling back to locator.ariaSnapshot). Passes when the serialized snapshot contains button semantics (loose contains check), proving the AX tree surface is readable through the framework.

Real Playwright wires a dialog handler (accept), then evaluates an IIFE that logs a marker to the console and calls window.confirm. Passes when the confirm return value is true (accepted dialog writes back into page JS - the Moli A5 target), the captured console contains the marker, and the recorded dialogs include a confirm.

Reads a deterministic AX target, inserts an unrelated sibling, reads the target again, and requires the raw backendDOMNodeId or MCP uid mapping to remain stable. [scenario:agentloop_ax_id_stable_across_mutation driver:puppeteer]

Fetches the full accessibility tree through each driver's own CDP route, finds a deterministic button, and requires its role, computed accessible name, and backendDOMNodeId to survive the adapter boundary. [scenario:agentloop_ax_role_name_ids driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds one item, and answers with the server-computed cart total. [scenario:app_add_single_item driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds an item, reloads the document, and answers with the total restored from server state. [scenario:app_cart_persists_reload driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds two items with different prices, and answers with the aggregated total. [scenario:app_cart_total_two_items driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds one item, checks out, and answers with the order id the server derived from the cart. [scenario:app_checkout_receipt driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, types a filter prefix, and answers with the live match counter. [scenario:app_filter_narrows driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, filters to the gizmo group, adds the first match, and answers with its cart line. [scenario:app_filter_then_add driver:puppeteer]
Runs the entire flow and answers with greeting plus receipt, every part server-computed. [scenario:app_full_flow_aggregate driver:puppeteer]
Clears any leftover session cookie, reloads, and confirms the server refuses the item list. [scenario:app_locked_without_login driver:puppeteer]
Fills the user field, logs in, and answers with the greeting the server echoed back. [scenario:app_login_greets driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, logs out, and answers with the server farewell plus the relocked list marker. [scenario:app_logout_locks driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds one item twice, and answers with the cart line plus total. [scenario:app_qty_accumulates driver:puppeteer]
Logs in, adds two items, removes one, and answers with the corrected total. [scenario:app_remove_item driver:puppeteer]

Calls CSS.getComputedStyleForNode through each raw-capable driver, requires at least 100 distinct properties, and verifies display, visibility, opacity, and pointer-events remain readable. [scenario:computed_style_breadth driver:puppeteer]

Sets a window global in one evaluate call and derives a value from it in a second call. A driver that evaluates each expression in a throwaway context (or a fresh isolated world) fails here. [scenario:cs_eval_context_persists driver:puppeteer]

Sets a window global on the first page, then creates a new page on the same URL and confirms the global is absent. Exercises that new targets get fresh execution contexts rather than reusing the old page's world. [scenario:cs_fresh_page_no_stale_globals driver:puppeteer]

Navigates and immediately asks the page for its readyState through the driver's evaluate surface. A driver that returns from goto before the document settles fails here. [scenario:cs_ready_state_complete driver:puppeteer]

Navigates the first page to the core fixture, creates a second page, navigates it to /page2 and reads its heading. The first page's location must not constrain the second target's navigation. [scenario:cs_second_page_independent_nav driver:puppeteer]

Creates three pages in sequence, navigating each, and reads the heading from the last one. Exercises session/bookkeeping stability across repeated target creation within one attempt. [scenario:cs_session_survives_three_pages driver:puppeteer]

Fills an input on the first page, then creates a second page on the same fixture and confirms its input is untouched. Exercises multi-target isolation within one driver session. [scenario:cs_two_pages_isolated driver:puppeteer]

Reads the user agent through the driver's own identity surface and through page JavaScript. Exercises the session's identity plumbing end to end; every engine spoofs a Mozilla-family UA, so the page-observed value must contain 'Mozilla/'. [scenario:cs_ua_surface driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to the core fixture and reads the current URL through the driver's own url surface (not page JS). The reported location must contain the fixture path. [scenario:cs_url_surface driver:puppeteer]
Clicks the attachment link, captures the download to the artifact dir, and answers with the probe-computed sha256 prefix and size of the saved bytes. [scenario:dl_download_checksum driver:puppeteer]
Arms an auto-accept dialog handler, clicks a button whose handler alerts a script-computed message, and answers with the recorded dialog log. [scenario:dlg_alert_message driver:puppeteer]
Arms an accepting dialog handler and clicks a button whose confirm() result is written into the DOM with a computed suffix. [scenario:dlg_confirm_accept driver:puppeteer]
Arms a dismissing dialog handler and confirms the page observes confirm() === false. [scenario:dlg_confirm_dismiss driver:puppeteer]
Arms an accepting dialog handler carrying prompt text and confirms the page receives exactly that text instead of the default. [scenario:dlg_prompt_text driver:puppeteer]

One click raises an alert then a confirm; the armed handler must resolve both so the page reaches its computed end state, and the dialog log must show both entries. [scenario:dlg_sequence_two_dialogs driver:puppeteer]

Clicks #counter-btn three times on the probe controls page; each click increments the #press-count output via a JS handler. Reads the final tally. Exercises repeated pointer dispatch and observation of client-side state accumulation. [scenario:dyn_counter_clicks driver:puppeteer]

On the paging fixture each #next click advances a counter and fetches that page's datum over XHR. The final datum P3-FINAL-73 exists only on page 3, reachable after two clicks, so it can only be read by waiting for each async update. Exercises polling/event-driven waiting across real network round-trips. [scenario:dyn_paging_final driver:puppeteer]

Checks the #checkbox input and reads its live .checked property via evaluate. Exercises the check contract: the driver must toggle the control to a checked state observable on the DOM property, not merely dispatch a click. [scenario:form_checkbox_check driver:puppeteer]

Checks the #agree checkbox on the probe controls page; the change handler writes 'checked' into #agree-out. Reads it back. Unlike a bare .checked read, this asserts the driver's check dispatches a real change event the page can react to. [scenario:form_checkbox_event driver:puppeteer]
Fills the same input twice; fill semantics require clear-then-set, so only the second value must remain. [scenario:form_fill_overwrites driver:puppeteer]

Fills the #field text input with a distinctive value and reads it back via input_value. Exercises the fill contract end to end: the driver must set the input's live value and observe it, proving keyboard/value semantics rather than just a DOM attribute. [scenario:form_fill_readback driver:puppeteer]
Focuses the core text field through each driver's public route or documented Runtime.evaluate fallback, then verifies the page's active element. [scenario:form_focus_active_element driver:puppeteer]
Clicks the label (not the checkbox) and reads the change-handler output; label activation semantics must reach the associated control. [scenario:form_label_click_toggles driver:puppeteer]
Presses Enter inside a text field whose keydown handler records the event; exercises real key-event dispatch, not value mutation. [scenario:form_press_enter_handler driver:puppeteer]
Clicks the second radio in a group and derives which one the group reports as checked. [scenario:form_radio_pick driver:puppeteer]

Selects the Engineering option in the #dept dropdown on the probe controls page; the page's change handler writes 'picked:eng' into #dept-out. Reads it back. Exercises select_option and confirms the driver triggers the change event rather than only setting value. [scenario:form_select_option driver:puppeteer]

Fills the query input, clicks submit, waits for the reloaded document, and reads the server-echoed query value. Exercises the full fill -> submit -> navigation -> readback chain. [scenario:form_submit_roundtrip driver:puppeteer]
Fills a textarea and reads its live value through the driver. [scenario:form_textarea_fill driver:puppeteer]

Both static children post a greeting on load; the parent collects them and answers with the sorted join, proving frame scripts executed and the message channel works. [scenario:fr_child_posts_parent driver:puppeteer]

Sets a marker on the parent, navigates the first child frame to a new URL, and answers with the child's new message plus proof the parent was not reloaded. [scenario:fr_child_self_navigation driver:puppeteer]

Inserts an iframe served from the localhost alias of the fixture origin (different origin string, same server), waits for it to load, and confirms the same-origin policy throws SecurityError on document access. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_blocked driver:puppeteer]

Inserts a cross-origin child and reads its script-computed message via a frame-scoped evaluate, the only legal route into a cross-origin frame. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_frame_evaluate driver:puppeteer]
Inserts a third iframe after load and reads its script-computed message once the new frame's document is live. [scenario:fr_dynamic_iframe_attach driver:puppeteer]
Counts frames before and after inserting a child that itself embeds a grandchild, answering with the observed growth of the reachable same-origin tree. [scenario:fr_frame_tree_shape driver:puppeteer]
Records the initial frame count, removes the first static iframe, waits for the tree to shrink, and answers with the before:after counts. [scenario:fr_iframe_detach driver:puppeteer]

Inserts a child that embeds its own child; the top document reads the grandchild's script-computed message through two levels of same-origin frame traversal. [scenario:fr_nested_two_levels driver:puppeteer]

Under site isolation a cross-origin iframe runs out-of-process; the driver must still enumerate it, evaluate inside it, and observe the frame tree shrink after removal. [scenario:fr_oopif_attach_read_detach driver:puppeteer]
Pokes a computed value into child A's note element and answers with both children's notes, proving sibling frame documents are distinct. [scenario:fr_sibling_isolation driver:puppeteer]
Waits for both static children to load and reads the first child's script-computed message through the frame tree. [scenario:fr_static_child_read driver:puppeteer]
Reads #lead + .next through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_adjacent_sibling driver:puppeteer]

Clicks a button addressed by [data-x="go-7"] and reads its handler output. Exercises attribute-selector support in the driver's element resolution. [scenario:loc_attribute_selector_click driver:puppeteer]
Counts .card elements through the driver's count surface. [scenario:loc_class_count driver:puppeteer]
Reads #zone .value where an identical .value also exists outside #zone; the scoped match must win. [scenario:loc_descendant_scope driver:puppeteer]
Clicks .btn where two buttons match; querySelector semantics require the FIRST one, whose handler records its rank. [scenario:loc_first_match_semantics driver:puppeteer]
Waits for a srcdoc iframe's document and reads a value computed inside it via contentDocument traversal. [scenario:loc_iframe_same_origin_read driver:puppeteer]
Both the top document and the iframe contain #dup. The driver's selector surface must return the TOP document's element. [scenario:loc_iframe_scope_top_document driver:puppeteer]
Reads a selector that matches nothing; the op must fail cleanly (step_fails) and the attempt derives its answer from that failure. [scenario:loc_missing_element_fails_cleanly driver:puppeteer]
Reads li:nth-child(2) from a three-item list through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_nth_child_text driver:puppeteer]
The page attaches a closed shadow root; element.shadowRoot must be null while the host still renders. Confirms closed-mode encapsulation. [scenario:loc_shadow_closed_hidden driver:puppeteer]

The page attaches an open shadow root at load. Reads the shadow content via explicit shadowRoot traversal - the engine must implement attachShadow and expose shadowRoot. [scenario:loc_shadow_open_pierce driver:puppeteer]

Fills #textbox with a five-character value on the probe controls page; the input handler writes the live length into #textbox-len. Reads it back. Exercises selector resolution plus input-event-derived DOM observation. [scenario:locator_textbox_len driver:puppeteer]
Opens two live targets, reads a distinct heading from each, and aggregates both values in the second tab through same-origin session state. [scenario:multi_tab_collect driver:puppeteer]
Navigates core -> page2, then drives the browser's history back through the driver's own surface and confirms the first document's heading is restored. [scenario:nav_back_restores driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to the core fixture, then to a second page, and reads the second page's #title. Exercises a second full navigation (document swap) and confirms the driver observes the new document rather than the stale first one. [scenario:nav_cross_page driver:puppeteer]
Navigates core -> page2, goes back, then forward again, and reads the second document's heading. [scenario:nav_forward_after_back driver:puppeteer]
Sets location.hash in-page and confirms both the hash and that no document reload happened (a marker global survives). [scenario:nav_hash_change driver:puppeteer]
Pushes a same-document history entry with a query string and derives the new search plus proof that the document did not reload. [scenario:nav_push_state driver:puppeteer]
Pushes a same-document entry, then drives history back through the driver and confirms the original URL is restored without a reload. [scenario:nav_push_state_back driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to an endpoint that 302-redirects twice before landing on a page carrying a redirect-count marker. The driver must settle on the FINAL document. [scenario:nav_redirect_chain driver:puppeteer]

Fills an input, reloads the page, and confirms the fresh document no longer carries the typed value. Exercises Page.reload semantics: a real reload must produce a new document, not restore transient DOM state. [scenario:nav_reload_resets_dom driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to the core fixture, reloads it, and re-reads #title. Exercises the reload lifecycle: the driver must drive a fresh document load and still resolve the selector against the reloaded page. [scenario:nav_reload_title driver:puppeteer]

Pushes one history entry, replaces it in place, then navigates back once. If replaceState correctly rewrote the pushed entry, a single back lands on the original URL with no query string. A driver or engine that materialises replaceState as an extra entry lands on the intermediate URL instead. [scenario:nav_replace_state_collapses_entry driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to an endpoint that holds the response for 1.2s before serving the document. A driver that gives up early or reads before the body arrives fails. [scenario:nav_slow_document driver:puppeteer]

Opens a page, navigates to the core fixture, and reads the #title heading text. Exercises the most basic navigation + DOM-read contract that every driver must honor. [scenario:nav_title_read driver:puppeteer]
Arms an abort route on the pixel image, then triggers an image load; the page's onerror handler must fire. [scenario:net_abort_subresource_image driver:puppeteer]

Fetches the protected endpoint without credentials (observes 401), then arms the Authorization header and fetches again; the page accumulates the two-phase trace. [scenario:net_auth_challenge_then_pass driver:puppeteer]
Sets a bearer token via extra headers and fetches the protected endpoint; the server must accept and return its computed body. [scenario:net_auth_header_roundtrip driver:puppeteer]
Arms a fulfill route on a virtual path and navigates to it; the rendered document must be the mock, proving document-level interception. [scenario:net_document_fulfill driver:puppeteer]
Sets an x-abb header on the session and fetches the echo endpoint; the server-rendered echo must contain exactly the driver's header value. [scenario:net_extra_headers_echo driver:puppeteer]
Arms a fulfill route on /net/data only, then fetches /net/data and /net/other together; the answer must show the first mocked and the second real. [scenario:net_mock_only_matching driver:puppeteer]
Starts request recording, triggers a fetch, and answers with the recorded request log filtered to the data endpoint. [scenario:net_request_recorded driver:puppeteer]
Arms an abort route on the data endpoint; the page fetch must reject and the page records the error name. [scenario:net_route_abort_handled driver:puppeteer]
Fulfills the data endpoint as text/csv; the page reads the response content-type header. [scenario:net_route_content_type driver:puppeteer]
Arms a fulfill route on the data endpoint; the page fetch must observe the mocked payload, not the server one. [scenario:net_route_mock_json driver:puppeteer]
Control case for the family: with no interception armed, the page fetch must hit the real endpoint and compute from the server payload. [scenario:net_route_passthrough driver:puppeteer]
Fulfills the data endpoint with a 503; the page must observe exactly that status. [scenario:net_route_rewrite_status driver:puppeteer]
Takes an ARIA snapshot of the main region and checks the computed heading appears in the structured output. [scenario:obs_aria_snapshot_structure driver:puppeteer]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks the computed heading text is exposed on the tree. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_heading driver:puppeteer]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks it contains the accessible name that the page computed at load. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_label driver:puppeteer]
Reads the bounding box of a 120x48 element and answers with its rounded dimensions — the box-model observation surface. [scenario:obs_box_model_geometry driver:puppeteer]
Clicks a button that emits console.error and answers with the driver's console capture. [scenario:obs_console_error_captured driver:puppeteer]
Clicks a button that logs a computed message and answers with the driver's console capture. [scenario:obs_console_log_captured driver:puppeteer]
Answers with the live document title joined with the pathname — the most basic observation pair every driver must expose. [scenario:obs_title_url_surface driver:puppeteer]
Computes a visibility matrix over a visible and a hidden element from live layout state. [scenario:obs_visibility_matrix driver:puppeteer]
Sets a cookie via document.cookie and parses it back out of the cookie string. [scenario:st_cookie_document_roundtrip driver:puppeteer]
Sets a cookie, reloads, and parses the cookie back. Exercises cookie-jar persistence across navigation. [scenario:st_cookie_survives_reload driver:puppeteer]
Writes a localStorage key and reads it back through a second evaluate call. The value is computed at write time, never present in the page. [scenario:st_local_roundtrip driver:puppeteer]

Writes localStorage in the first page, creates a second page on the same origin, and reads the key there. Same-origin pages must observe one storage area. [scenario:st_local_shared_same_origin driver:puppeteer]
Writes a localStorage key, reloads the page, and reads the key back. Exercises storage persistence across the driver's reload path. [scenario:st_local_survives_reload driver:puppeteer]

Writes sessionStorage in the first page, creates a fresh page on the same origin, and confirms the key is absent there - sessionStorage is per top-level browsing context. [scenario:st_session_isolated_new_page driver:puppeteer]
Writes and reads a sessionStorage key within one page session. [scenario:st_session_storage_roundtrip driver:puppeteer]
Writes two keys, removes one, and derives which keys remain. [scenario:st_storage_remove driver:puppeteer]

Attaches the payload to a bare file input (no submit); the page's change handler reads it with FileReader and writes a computed digest of length and first token. [scenario:up_upload_filereader driver:puppeteer]

Writes a payload file, attaches it to the form input, submits, and answers with the server-rendered upload receipt (name, size, sha256 prefix) — graded server-side against the known payload. [scenario:up_upload_server_checksum driver:puppeteer]
An attribute is set 300ms after load. Waits for it via predicate, then reads it through the driver's attribute surface (not page JS). [scenario:wait_attribute_set driver:puppeteer]

An element visible at load is display:none'd after 300ms. Waits for the hidden state via a predicate and reports it; a driver that only waits for presence passes too early. [scenario:wait_element_hidden driver:puppeteer]

A button starts disabled and is enabled 350ms after load; its click handler is attached at enable time. Waits for enablement, clicks, and reads the handler's output. [scenario:wait_enabled_then_click driver:puppeteer]

Navigates to the probe controls page and waits for #late-item, which the page appends via setTimeout ~300ms after load, then reads its text. Exercises event-driven waiting for a DOM node that does not exist at load time. [scenario:wait_late_item driver:puppeteer]
Three list items are appended at 150/300/450ms. Waits until all three exist and derives the joined item text. [scenario:wait_list_progressive_fill driver:puppeteer]
Waits for a span inserted 400ms after load and reads its computed text. A driver that only samples the initial DOM misses it. [scenario:wait_slow_badge driver:puppeteer]

The final datum P3-FINAL-73 exists only on page 3, reachable after two clicks, so it can only be read by waiting for each async update. Exercises polling/event-driven waiting across real network round-trips. [scenario:dyn_paging_final driver:cdp_use]

Checks the #checkbox input and reads its live .checked property via evaluate. Exercises the check contract: the driver must toggle the control to a checked state observable on the DOM property, not merely dispatch a click. [scenario:form_checkbox_check driver:cdp_use]

Checks the #agree checkbox on the probe controls page; the change handler writes 'checked' into #agree-out. Reads it back. Unlike a bare .checked read, this asserts the driver's check dispatches a real change event the page can react to. [scenario:form_checkbox_event driver:cdp_use]
Fills the same input twice; fill semantics require clear-then-set, so only the second value must remain. [scenario:form_fill_overwrites driver:cdp_use]

Fills the #field text input with a distinctive value and reads it back via input_value. Exercises the fill contract end to end: the driver must set the input's live value and observe it, proving keyboard/value semantics rather than just a DOM attribute. [scenario:form_fill_readback driver:cdp_use]
Focuses the core text field through each driver's public route or documented Runtime.evaluate fallback, then verifies the page's active element. [scenario:form_focus_active_element driver:cdp_use]
Clicks the label (not the checkbox) and reads the change-handler output; label activation semantics must reach the associated control. [scenario:form_label_click_toggles driver:cdp_use]
Presses Enter inside a text field whose keydown handler records the event; exercises real key-event dispatch, not value mutation. [scenario:form_press_enter_handler driver:cdp_use]
Clicks the second radio in a group and derives which one the group reports as checked. [scenario:form_radio_pick driver:cdp_use]

Selects the Engineering option in the #dept dropdown on the probe controls page; the page's change handler writes 'picked:eng' into #dept-out. Reads it back. Exercises select_option and confirms the driver triggers the change event rather than only setting value. [scenario:form_select_option driver:cdp_use]

Fills the query input, clicks submit, waits for the reloaded document, and reads the server-echoed query value. Exercises the full fill -> submit -> navigation -> readback chain. [scenario:form_submit_roundtrip driver:cdp_use]
Fills a textarea and reads its live value through the driver. [scenario:form_textarea_fill driver:cdp_use]

Both static children post a greeting on load; the parent collects them and answers with the sorted join, proving frame scripts executed and the message channel works. [scenario:fr_child_posts_parent driver:cdp_use]

Sets a marker on the parent, navigates the first child frame to a new URL, and answers with the child's new message plus proof the parent was not reloaded. [scenario:fr_child_self_navigation driver:cdp_use]

Inserts an iframe served from the localhost alias of the fixture origin (different origin string, same server), waits for it to load, and confirms the same-origin policy throws SecurityError on document access. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_blocked driver:cdp_use]
Inserts a third iframe after load and reads its script-computed message once the new frame's document is live. [scenario:fr_dynamic_iframe_attach driver:cdp_use]
Counts frames before and after inserting a child that itself embeds a grandchild, answering with the observed growth of the reachable same-origin tree. [scenario:fr_frame_tree_shape driver:cdp_use]
Records the initial frame count, removes the first static iframe, waits for the tree to shrink, and answers with the before:after counts. [scenario:fr_iframe_detach driver:cdp_use]

Inserts a child that embeds its own child; the top document reads the grandchild's script-computed message through two levels of same-origin frame traversal. [scenario:fr_nested_two_levels driver:cdp_use]
Pokes a computed value into child A's note element and answers with both children's notes, proving sibling frame documents are distinct. [scenario:fr_sibling_isolation driver:cdp_use]
Waits for both static children to load and reads the first child's script-computed message through the frame tree. [scenario:fr_static_child_read driver:cdp_use]
Reads #lead + .next through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_adjacent_sibling driver:cdp_use]

Clicks a button addressed by [data-x="go-7"] and reads its handler output. Exercises attribute-selector support in the driver's element resolution. [scenario:loc_attribute_selector_click driver:cdp_use]
Counts .card elements through the driver's count surface. [scenario:loc_class_count driver:cdp_use]
Reads #zone .value where an identical .value also exists outside #zone; the scoped match must win. [scenario:loc_descendant_scope driver:cdp_use]
Clicks .btn where two buttons match; querySelector semantics require the FIRST one, whose handler records its rank. [scenario:loc_first_match_semantics driver:cdp_use]
Waits for a srcdoc iframe's document and reads a value computed inside it via contentDocument traversal. [scenario:loc_iframe_same_origin_read driver:cdp_use]
Both the top document and the iframe contain #dup. The driver's selector surface must return the TOP document's element. [scenario:loc_iframe_scope_top_document driver:cdp_use]
Reads a selector that matches nothing; the op must fail cleanly (step_fails) and the attempt derives its answer from that failure. [scenario:loc_missing_element_fails_cleanly driver:cdp_use]
Reads li:nth-child(2) from a three-item list through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_nth_child_text driver:cdp_use]
The page attaches a closed shadow root; element.shadowRoot must be null while the host still renders. Confirms closed-mode encapsulation. [scenario:loc_shadow_closed_hidden driver:cdp_use]

The page attaches an open shadow root at load. Reads the shadow content via explicit shadowRoot traversal - the engine must implement attachShadow and expose shadowRoot. [scenario:loc_shadow_open_pierce driver:cdp_use]

Fills #textbox with a five-character value on the probe controls page; the input handler writes the live length into #textbox-len. Reads it back. Exercises selector resolution plus input-event-derived DOM observation. [scenario:locator_textbox_len driver:cdp_use]
Opens two live targets, reads a distinct heading from each, and aggregates both values in the second tab through same-origin session state. [scenario:multi_tab_collect driver:cdp_use]
Navigates core -> page2, then drives the browser's history back through the driver's own surface and confirms the first document's heading is restored. [scenario:nav_back_restores driver:cdp_use]

Navigates to the core fixture, then to a second page, and reads the second page's #title. Exercises a second full navigation (document swap) and confirms the driver observes the new document rather than the stale first one. [scenario:nav_cross_page driver:cdp_use]
Navigates core -> page2, goes back, then forward again, and reads the second document's heading. [scenario:nav_forward_after_back driver:cdp_use]
Sets location.hash in-page and confirms both the hash and that no document reload happened (a marker global survives). [scenario:nav_hash_change driver:cdp_use]
Pushes a same-document history entry with a query string and derives the new search plus proof that the document did not reload. [scenario:nav_push_state driver:cdp_use]
Pushes a same-document entry, then drives history back through the driver and confirms the original URL is restored without a reload. [scenario:nav_push_state_back driver:cdp_use]
Navigates to an endpoint that 302-redirects twice before landing on a page carrying a redirect-count marker. The driver must settle on the FINAL document. [scenario:nav_redirect_chain driver:cdp_use]

Fills an input, reloads the page, and confirms the fresh document no longer carries the typed value. Exercises Page.reload semantics: a real reload must produce a new document, not restore transient DOM state. [scenario:nav_reload_resets_dom driver:cdp_use]

Navigates to the core fixture, reloads it, and re-reads #title. Exercises the reload lifecycle: the driver must drive a fresh document load and still resolve the selector against the reloaded page. [scenario:nav_reload_title driver:cdp_use]

Pushes one history entry, replaces it in place, then navigates back once. If replaceState correctly rewrote the pushed entry, a single back lands on the original URL with no query string. A driver or engine that materialises replaceState as an extra entry lands on the intermediate URL instead. [scenario:nav_replace_state_collapses_entry driver:cdp_use]
Navigates to an endpoint that holds the response for 1.2s before serving the document. A driver that gives up early or reads before the body arrives fails. [scenario:nav_slow_document driver:cdp_use]

Opens a page, navigates to the core fixture, and reads the #title heading text. Exercises the most basic navigation + DOM-read contract that every driver must honor. [scenario:nav_title_read driver:cdp_use]
Control case for the family: with no interception armed, the page fetch must hit the real endpoint and compute from the server payload. [scenario:net_route_passthrough driver:cdp_use]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks the computed heading text is exposed on the tree. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_heading driver:cdp_use]
Takes an AX snapshot and checks it contains the accessible name that the page computed at load. [scenario:obs_ax_snapshot_label driver:cdp_use]
Reads the bounding box of a 120x48 element and answers with its rounded dimensions — the box-model observation surface. [scenario:obs_box_model_geometry driver:cdp_use]
Answers with the live document title joined with the pathname — the most basic observation pair every driver must expose. [scenario:obs_title_url_surface driver:cdp_use]
Computes a visibility matrix over a visible and a hidden element from live layout state. [scenario:obs_visibility_matrix driver:cdp_use]
Sets a cookie via document.cookie and parses it back out of the cookie string. [scenario:st_cookie_document_roundtrip driver:cdp_use]
Sets a cookie, reloads, and parses the cookie back. Exercises cookie-jar persistence across navigation. [scenario:st_cookie_survives_reload driver:cdp_use]
Writes a localStorage key and reads it back through a second evaluate call. The value is computed at write time, never present in the page. [scenario:st_local_roundtrip driver:cdp_use]

Writes localStorage in the first page, creates a second page on the same origin, and reads the key there. Same-origin pages must observe one storage area. [scenario:st_local_shared_same_origin driver:cdp_use]
Writes a localStorage key, reloads the page, and reads the key back. Exercises storage persistence across the driver's reload path. [scenario:st_local_survives_reload driver:cdp_use]

Writes sessionStorage in the first page, creates a fresh page on the same origin, and confirms the key is absent there - sessionStorage is per top-level browsing context. [scenario:st_session_isolated_new_page driver:cdp_use]
Writes and reads a sessionStorage key within one page session. [scenario:st_session_storage_roundtrip driver:cdp_use]
Writes two keys, removes one, and derives which keys remain. [scenario:st_storage_remove driver:cdp_use]
An attribute is set 300ms after load. Waits for it via predicate, then reads it through the driver's attribute surface (not page JS). [scenario:wait_attribute_set driver:cdp_use]

An element visible at load is display:none'd after 300ms. Waits for the hidden state via a predicate and reports it; a driver that only waits for presence passes too early. [scenario:wait_element_hidden driver:cdp_use]

A button starts disabled and is enabled 350ms after load; its click handler is attached at enable time. Waits for enablement, clicks, and reads the handler's output. [scenario:wait_enabled_then_click driver:cdp_use]

Navigates to the probe controls page and waits for #late-item, which the page appends via setTimeout ~300ms after load, then reads its text. Exercises event-driven waiting for a DOM node that does not exist at load time. [scenario:wait_late_item driver:cdp_use]
Three list items are appended at 150/300/450ms. Waits until all three exist and derives the joined item text. [scenario:wait_list_progressive_fill driver:cdp_use]
Waits for a span inserted 400ms after load and reads its computed text. A driver that only samples the initial DOM misses it. [scenario:wait_slow_badge driver:cdp_use]
A container holds a spinner that is replaced with content 500ms after load. Waits for the spinner to disappear and reads the replacement. [scenario:wait_spinner_replaced driver:cdp_use]

The status text changes twice (warming -> phase:1 -> phase:2:W7). Waits for the FINAL state; a driver that returns on the first mutation reads the intermediate value. [scenario:wait_two_phase_settle driver:cdp_use]

Reads a deterministic AX target, inserts an unrelated sibling, reads the target again, and requires the raw backendDOMNodeId or MCP uid mapping to remain stable. [scenario:agentloop_ax_id_stable_across_mutation driver:pydoll]

Fetches the full accessibility tree through each driver's own CDP route, finds a deterministic button, and requires its role, computed accessible name, and backendDOMNodeId to survive the adapter boundary. [scenario:agentloop_ax_role_name_ids driver:pydoll]
Logs in, adds one item, and answers with the server-computed cart total. [scenario:app_add_single_item driver:pydoll]
Logs in, adds an item, reloads the document, and answers with the total restored from server state. [scenario:app_cart_persists_reload driver:pydoll]
Logs in, adds two items with different prices, and answers with the aggregated total. [scenario:app_cart_total_two_items driver:pydoll]
Logs in, adds one item, checks out, and answers with the order id the server derived from the cart. [scenario:app_checkout_receipt driver:pydoll]
Logs in, types a filter prefix, and answers with the live match counter. [scenario:app_filter_narrows driver:pydoll]
Logs in, filters to the gizmo group, adds the first match, and answers with its cart line. [scenario:app_filter_then_add driver:pydoll]
Runs the entire flow and answers with greeting plus receipt, every part server-computed. [scenario:app_full_flow_aggregate driver:pydoll]
Clears any leftover session cookie, reloads, and confirms the server refuses the item list. [scenario:app_locked_without_login driver:pydoll]
Fills the user field, logs in, and answers with the greeting the server echoed back. [scenario:app_login_greets driver:pydoll]
Logs in, logs out, and answers with the server farewell plus the relocked list marker. [scenario:app_logout_locks driver:pydoll]
Logs in, adds one item twice, and answers with the cart line plus total. [scenario:app_qty_accumulates driver:pydoll]

Sets a window global in one evaluate call and derives a value from it in a second call. A driver that evaluates each expression in a throwaway context (or a fresh isolated world) fails here. [scenario:cs_eval_context_persists driver:pydoll]

Sets a window global on the first page, then creates a new page on the same URL and confirms the global is absent. Exercises that new targets get fresh execution contexts rather than reusing the old page's world. [scenario:cs_fresh_page_no_stale_globals driver:pydoll]

Logs in, adds one item, and answers with the server-computed cart total. [scenario:app_add_single_item driver:stagehand]
Logs in, adds an item, reloads the document, and answers with the total restored from server state. [scenario:app_cart_persists_reload driver:stagehand]
Logs in, adds two items with different prices, and answers with the aggregated total. [scenario:app_cart_total_two_items driver:stagehand]
Logs in, adds one item, checks out, and answers with the order id the server derived from the cart. [scenario:app_checkout_receipt driver:stagehand]

Runs the entire flow and answers with greeting plus receipt, every part server-computed. [scenario:app_full_flow_aggregate driver:stagehand]
Clears any leftover session cookie, reloads, and confirms the server refuses the item list. [scenario:app_locked_without_login driver:stagehand]
Fills the user field, logs in, and answers with the greeting the server echoed back. [scenario:app_login_greets driver:stagehand]
Logs in, logs out, and answers with the server farewell plus the relocked list marker. [scenario:app_logout_locks driver:stagehand]
Logs in, adds one item twice, and answers with the cart line plus total. [scenario:app_qty_accumulates driver:stagehand]
Logs in, adds two items, removes one, and answers with the corrected total. [scenario:app_remove_item driver:stagehand]

Calls CSS.getComputedStyleForNode through each raw-capable driver, requires at least 100 distinct properties, and verifies display, visibility, opacity, and pointer-events remain readable. [scenario:computed_style_breadth driver:stagehand]

Sets a window global in one evaluate call and derives a value from it in a second call. A driver that evaluates each expression in a throwaway context (or a fresh isolated world) fails here. [scenario:cs_eval_context_persists driver:stagehand]

Sets a window global on the first page, then creates a new page on the same URL and confirms the global is absent. Exercises that new targets get fresh execution contexts rather than reusing the old page's world. [scenario:cs_fresh_page_no_stale_globals driver:stagehand]

Navigates and immediately asks the page for its readyState through the driver's evaluate surface. A driver that returns from goto before the document settles fails here. [scenario:cs_ready_state_complete driver:stagehand]

Fills an input on the first page, then creates a second page on the same fixture and confirms its input is untouched. Exercises multi-target isolation within one driver session. [scenario:cs_two_pages_isolated driver:stagehand]

On the paging fixture each #next click advances a counter and fetches that page's datum over XHR. Checks the #checkbox input and reads its live .checked property via evaluate. Exercises the check contract: the driver must toggle the control to a checked state observable on the DOM property, not merely dispatch a click. [scenario:form_checkbox_check driver:stagehand]

Fills the same input twice; fill semantics require clear-then-set, so only the second value must remain. [scenario:form_fill_overwrites driver:stagehand]

Fills the #field text input with a distinctive value and reads it back via input_value. Presses Enter inside a text field whose keydown handler records the event; exercises real key-event dispatch, not value mutation. [scenario:form_press_enter_handler driver:stagehand]
Clicks the second radio in a group and derives which one the group reports as checked. [scenario:form_radio_pick driver:stagehand]

Counts frames before and after inserting a child that itself embeds a grandchild, answering with the observed growth of the reachable same-origin tree. [scenario:fr_frame_tree_shape driver:stagehand]

Reads #lead + .next through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_adjacent_sibling driver:stagehand]

Clicks a button addressed by [data-x="go-7"] and reads its handler output. Exercises attribute-selector support in the driver's element resolution. [scenario:loc_attribute_selector_click driver:stagehand]
Counts .card elements through the driver's count surface. [scenario:loc_class_count driver:stagehand]
Reads #zone .value where an identical .value also exists outside #zone; the scoped match must win. [scenario:loc_descendant_scope driver:stagehand]

Waits for a srcdoc iframe's document and reads a value computed inside it via contentDocument traversal. [scenario:loc_iframe_same_origin_read driver:stagehand]

Reads li:nth-child(2) from a three-item list through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_nth_child_text driver:stagehand]

Writes a localStorage key and reads it back through a second evaluate call. The value is computed at write time, never present in the page. [scenario:st_local_roundtrip driver:chrome_devtools_mcp]

Writes a localStorage key, reloads the page, and reads the key back. Exercises storage persistence across the driver's reload path. [scenario:st_local_survives_reload driver:chrome_devtools_mcp]

Clicks #counter-btn three times on the probe controls page; each click increments the #press-count output via a JS handler. Reads the final tally. Exercises repeated pointer dispatch and observation of client-side state accumulation. [scenario:dyn_counter_clicks driver:ferrum]

On the paging fixture each #next click advances a counter and fetches that page's datum over XHR. The final datum P3-FINAL-73 exists only on page 3, reachable after two clicks, so it can only be read by waiting for each async update. Exercises polling/event-driven waiting across real network round-trips. [scenario:dyn_paging_final driver:ferrum]

Checks the #checkbox input and reads its live .checked property via evaluate. Exercises the check contract: the driver must toggle the control to a checked state observable on the DOM property, not merely dispatch a click. [scenario:form_checkbox_check driver:ferrum]

Checks the #agree checkbox on the probe controls page; the change handler writes 'checked' into #agree-out. Reads it back. Unlike a bare .checked read, this asserts the driver's check dispatches a real change event the page can react to. [scenario:form_checkbox_event driver:ferrum]
Fills the same input twice; fill semantics require clear-then-set, so only the second value must remain. [scenario:form_fill_overwrites driver:ferrum]

Fills the #field text input with a distinctive value and reads it back via input_value. Exercises the fill contract end to end: the driver must set the input's live value and observe it, proving keyboard/value semantics rather than just a DOM attribute. [scenario:form_fill_readback driver:ferrum]
Focuses the core text field through each driver's public route or documented Runtime.evaluate fallback, then verifies the page's active element. [scenario:form_focus_active_element driver:ferrum]
Clicks the label (not the checkbox) and reads the change-handler output; label activation semantics must reach the associated control. [scenario:form_label_click_toggles driver:ferrum]
Presses Enter inside a text field whose keydown handler records the event; exercises real key-event dispatch, not value mutation. [scenario:form_press_enter_handler driver:ferrum]
Clicks the second radio in a group and derives which one the group reports as checked. [scenario:form_radio_pick driver:ferrum]

Selects the Engineering option in the #dept dropdown on the probe controls page; the page's change handler writes 'picked:eng' into #dept-out. Reads it back. Exercises select_option and confirms the driver triggers the change event rather than only setting value. [scenario:form_select_option driver:ferrum]

Fills the query input, clicks submit, waits for the reloaded document, and reads the server-echoed query value. Exercises the full fill -> submit -> navigation -> readback chain. [scenario:form_submit_roundtrip driver:ferrum]
Fills a textarea and reads its live value through the driver. [scenario:form_textarea_fill driver:ferrum]

Both static children post a greeting on load; the parent collects them and answers with the sorted join, proving frame scripts executed and the message channel works. [scenario:fr_child_posts_parent driver:ferrum]

Sets a marker on the parent, navigates the first child frame to a new URL, and answers with the child's new message plus proof the parent was not reloaded. [scenario:fr_child_self_navigation driver:ferrum]

Inserts an iframe served from the localhost alias of the fixture origin (different origin string, same server), waits for it to load, and confirms the same-origin policy throws SecurityError on document access. [scenario:fr_cross_origin_blocked driver:ferrum]
Inserts a third iframe after load and reads its script-computed message once the new frame's document is live. [scenario:fr_dynamic_iframe_attach driver:ferrum]
Counts frames before and after inserting a child that itself embeds a grandchild, answering with the observed growth of the reachable same-origin tree. [scenario:fr_frame_tree_shape driver:ferrum]
Records the initial frame count, removes the first static iframe, waits for the tree to shrink, and answers with the before:after counts. [scenario:fr_iframe_detach driver:ferrum]

Inserts a child that embeds its own child; the top document reads the grandchild's script-computed message through two levels of same-origin frame traversal. [scenario:fr_nested_two_levels driver:ferrum]
Pokes a computed value into child A's note element and answers with both children's notes, proving sibling frame documents are distinct. [scenario:fr_sibling_isolation driver:ferrum]
Waits for both static children to load and reads the first child's script-computed message through the frame tree. [scenario:fr_static_child_read driver:ferrum]
Reads #lead + .next through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_adjacent_sibling driver:ferrum]

Clicks a button addressed by [data-x="go-7"] and reads its handler output. Exercises attribute-selector support in the driver's element resolution. [scenario:loc_attribute_selector_click driver:ferrum]
Counts .card elements through the driver's count surface. [scenario:loc_class_count driver:ferrum]
Reads #zone .value where an identical .value also exists outside #zone; the scoped match must win. [scenario:loc_descendant_scope driver:ferrum]
Clicks .btn where two buttons match; querySelector semantics require the FIRST one, whose handler records its rank. [scenario:loc_first_match_semantics driver:ferrum]
Waits for a srcdoc iframe's document and reads a value computed inside it via contentDocument traversal. [scenario:loc_iframe_same_origin_read driver:ferrum]
Both the top document and the iframe contain #dup. The driver's selector surface must return the TOP document's element. [scenario:loc_iframe_scope_top_document driver:ferrum]
Reads a selector that matches nothing; the op must fail cleanly (step_fails) and the attempt derives its answer from that failure. [scenario:loc_missing_element_fails_cleanly driver:ferrum]
Reads li:nth-child(2) from a three-item list through the driver's text surface. [scenario:loc_nth_child_text driver:ferrum]

Opens two live targets, reads a distinct heading from each, and aggregates both values in the second tab through same-origin session state. [scenario:multi_tab_collect driver:ferrum]
